categories.main_business_segments: The company focuses on the development of clinical-stage drugs primarily in ophthalmology and oncology, including 505(b)(2) modified new drugs and antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) biosimilars. It also develops and applies the proprietary APNT® nanoparticle formulation technology platform to various drug formulations. Revenue mainly comes from licensing, royalties, and sales to authorized partners.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The core technology is the APNT® nanoparticle formulation platform, which reduces drug particle size to nanoscale to improve solubility, bioavailability, and drug delivery. The company uses contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) for production, leveraging advanced formulation and GMP-compliant manufacturing processes. It also develops ADC biosimilars with complex biologic and chemical conjugation techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are pharmaceutical companies and partners in major global markets including the United States, China, Brazil, Middle East, Europe, Canada, and others. The end markets are patients requiring ophthalmic treatments (post-surgical inflammation and pain) and HER2-positive breast cancer patients. The company licenses products to specialized pharmaceutical firms who handle local sales and distribution.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with key markets in the United States, China, Brazil, Middle East and North Africa, Israel, Canada, Portugal, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, India, and other countries across Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific. Production is based in Taiwan, supplying global partners.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug discovery, development, formulation technology, and clinical trials. It outsources manufacturing to CMOs and licenses products downstream to partners responsible for marketing and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing clinical-stage drug candidates (APP13007 and TSY-0110), expanding the APNT® nanoparticle technology platform, and pursuing global licensing partnerships. R&D focuses on ophthalmic drugs, ADC biosimilars for breast cancer, and infectious disease treatments. The company emphasizes regulatory compliance, clinical trial success, and cost-effective manufacturing scale-up.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through licensing fees, milestone payments, royalties from sales by licensees, and product sales to authorized partners. The company does not directly market products but supplies licensed partners who commercialize the drugs in their respective territories.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include major pharmaceutical companies such as Roche (Kadcyla®), Alcon, Bausch & Lomb, and other biosimilar developers. The company positions itself as a niche innovator with proprietary nanoparticle technology and as a first mover in ADC biosimilars targeting HER2-positive breast cancer, aiming to capture market share through differentiated products and global licensing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue growth from approximately NT$31 million in 2022 to NT$143 million in 2023, driven by licensing income from APP13007. Despite net losses, the losses have decreased significantly. The company has a market capitalization supported by cash and equity injections, with ongoing investments in R&D and clinical trials. It maintains a lean workforce of under 20 employees focused on R&D and management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers innovative drugs with improved efficacy, safety, and patient compliance, such as APP13007 which requires fewer daily doses and has lower side effects compared to existing ophthalmic steroids. Its APNT® nanoparticle technology enhances drug bioavailability and stability. TSY-0110 aims to be the first ADC biosimilar for HER2-positive breast cancer in major markets, providing a cost-effective alternative to branded biologics. The company leverages global patent protection and strategic partnerships to maximize market reach.
